requests.result: Official Yixing Natural Resources and Planning Bureau homepage retrieved. It identifies the bureau and links current notices, including the Tianditu·Yixing update article; no parcel API URL or schema was exposed in the inspected HTML.

Official Yixing Real Estate Registration Center service-point page retrieved. It lists municipal and township registration windows and confirms local registration presence; it exposes no parcel geometry service.

Official announcement retrieved. It states Tianditu·Yixing is an authoritative public geographic-information carrier, historically offered portal and service-interface modes, and is undergoing vector-data and resource-catalog updates. No current endpoint, parcel schema, native ID, or CRS was published.

Legacy domain referenced by a non-first-party 2014 report responded, but current HTML appears generic/unrelated and contains no qualified cadastral layer, feature service, schema, native parcel ID, CRS, or geometry. It was not used as source integration evidence.
Current Jiangsu Tianditu Wuxi portal responded with a small HTML shell. No parcel feature service or safe anonymous parcel response was identified in the bounded request.
